# Port-specific iptables rules for testing
*filter
:INPUT DROP [0:0]
:FORWARD DROP [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:STOP-BOTS - [0:0]

-I INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
-I INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT
-I INPUT -j STOP-BOTS

# Block specific ports for bots
-A STOP-BOTS -s 10.0.0.1 -p tcp --dport 80 -j DROP
-A STOP-BOTS -s 10.0.0.1 -p tcp --dport 443 -j DROP
-A STOP-BOTS -s 10.0.0.2 -p tcp --dport 22 -j DROP
-A STOP-BOTS -s 10.0.0.3 -p tcp --dport 8080 -j DROP
-A STOP-BOTS -s 10.0.0.4 -p udp --dport 53 -j DROP

# Allow specific ports for good bots
-A STOP-BOTS -s 66.249.64.0/19 -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT

COMMIT
